title: The transcript is built from ACP updates as data
body:
A transcript as plain data, built from ACP session updates, that the screen
renders and tests inspect, with nothing of ratatui in it.

## Proposal

`src/session.rs`: `Transcript { entries: Vec<Entry> }` where `Entry` is an
enum with one variant per thing that can appear: the user's prompt, agent
text, agent thought, a tool call with its current status, locations and
content, and the plan. Text chunks append to the last text entry of the same
kind; a tool call update finds its call by id and replaces status, content
and locations. One function, `apply(&mut self, update: SessionUpdate)`,
does all of it. A second, small struct holds what is not transcript: the
session id, whether a prompt is in flight, the last stop reason.

Tests feed it update sequences from scenarios and assert on entries.

## Rejected

- Rendering straight from ACP types. Chunks need joining and updates need
  resolving before anything is drawable, and that logic has to be testable
  without a terminal.
